versions.content: If the Rx freshness request function returns E_NOT_OK, the verification of an Authentic I - PDU is considered to be failed and the authentication retry counter for this PDU shall be incremented. If the number of authentication attempts has reached SecOCAuthenticationVerifyAttempts, the SecOC module shall remove the Authentic I - PDU from its internal buffer. The failure SECOC_E_RE_FRESHNESS_FAILURE shall be reported to the DET module .
